description: 引离d8黑车——变型：黑王逃h7，同样得后
explanation_en: Even if the king escapes the back-rank threat, Re8+ has still deflected the rook. White can capture the queen; if the rook recaptures, White wins the rook as well.

intro.popup: 💡 类似局面：引离d8黑车或黑王，白方如何得后？
intro.popup_en: 💡 A similar position: how can White deflect the rook from d8 or drive the king away to win the queen?

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Re8+后黑王逃h7（不在底线），但Qxd5照样得后！黑车若Rxd5，Rxa8额外赢车。
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: After Re8+, the king escapes to h7 instead of staying on the back rank, but Qxd5 still wins the queen. If the rook recaptures with Rxd5, Rxa8 wins the rook too.

moves.popup_en: White plays Re8+! The same deflection idea applies.

moves.popup: 黑王Kh7！这次黑王逃开，没有底线杀。
moves.popup_en: The king escapes to h7, avoiding the back-rank mate this time.

moves.popup: 白后Qxd5！白后得后！黑王在h7，无法阻止白后吃d5。
moves.popup_en: White captures the queen with Qxd5. With the king on h7, Black cannot stop it.
Black's rook recaptures on d5 in an attempt to limit the loss.

moves.popup: 白车Rxa8！额外赢车！白方大优。
moves.popup_en: White's rook captures on a8, winning an additional rook. White has a decisive advantage.
